GROUP(ORDER BY t2.id), ',',1,1)-1) ELSE LISTAGG(TO_char(t1.updated_time,'SYYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), ',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY t2.id) end AS updatedTime from tb_setting_template_stage t1 left join tb_alarm_setting_template t2 on t2.id = t1.alarm_template_stage_id where 1=1 and t2.early_warning_rule_name like concat(concat('%',#{alarmValueSettingDto.earlyWarningRuleName}),'%') and t2.material_code like concat(concat('%',#{alarmValueSettingDto.materialCode}),'%') and t2.maintence_style = #{alarmValueSettingDto.maintenceStyle} and t2.create_user =
